parsed.explanation: The controlling exposure is the parent regime the division cannot alter: birth-sex passport markers, X-marker phase-out, border screening that can refuse a case and weigh a lifetime fraud finding on perceived sex misrepresentation, documented immigration-custody abuse of trans detainees, and nationally fixed custody. Those are traveller-facing and unavoidable at the crossing, so the division cannot sit in the Reduced band regardless of local climate. What the division adds is genuinely protective and partly visitor-facing: gender-identity public-accommodations protection operating since 1993 (enforced in a 2014 settlement), hate-crime enhancement, abolition of the trans panic defence, a care shield expressly covering families travelling for treatment, sodomy repeal, and local M/F/X licensing. But the shield's application to foreign orders is unadjudicated, enforcement data are unsourced, and the documented 2012 birth-sex custody placement is dated evidence of practice. Above the national baseline, still Elevated.
